web.dashboard.title: Dashboard
web.errors.notFoundBody: This page doesn't exist in the new admin yet.
web.dashboard.noData: No data in the last 30 days.
web.lists.help.what: A list is a group of subscribers. Use lists as topics people opt in to, and send campaigns to one or more of them.
web.lists.help.private: Private lists are only visible to admins. Public lists appear on the public subscription page and in subscription forms.
web.lists.help.archive: Archive a list to hide it from pickers and public forms without deleting its subscribers.
web.subscribers.help.what: A subscriber is one e-mail address. Their subscriptions to lists carry the opt-in status.
web.subscribers.help.blocklist: Blocklisting stops all e-mail to this address, whatever lists they are on.
web.subscribers.help.attribs: Attributes are free-form JSON you can use in templates and in queries, for example city or plan.
web.templates.subjectRequired: A transactional template needs a subject.
web.templates.help.what: Campaign templates wrap the body of every campaign you send: header, footer, branding. The placeholder marks where the campaign content goes.
web.templates.help.tx: Transactional templates are complete messages with their own subject, sent through the API (and from automations).
web.campaigns.invalidHeaders: Headers must be a JSON array of objects, one header per object.
web.campaigns.help.what: A campaign is one message sent to one or more lists, now or on a schedule. Create it as a draft, write the content, send a test, then start it.
web.campaigns.help.content: Pick a format, a template and write the message. Switching format converts the content, which can lose formatting, so you are asked first. F9 previews it.
web.campaigns.help.lock: Once a campaign is running, finished or cancelled its content is locked. Pausing it makes it editable again.
web.analytics.pick: Choose one or more campaigns and a date range to see their views, clicks, bounces and links.
web.users.help.what: Users are the people who sign in to this admin. Each has one user role (what they can do) and optionally one list role (which lists they can see and manage).
web.users.help.api: API users have no password. Creating one shows its access token once; copy it then, it cannot be shown again.
web.users.help.roles: Roles are managed under User roles and List roles. A user without a list role can only reach lists through their user role.
web.roles.help.user: A user role is a set of permissions. The Super Admin role has everything and cannot be changed.
web.roles.help.list: A list role grants view and manage access to specific lists. It applies on top of the list permissions in the user role.
web.roles.highRisk: High risk: allows running raw SQL against subscribers
web.profile.passwordHelp: Leave blank to keep your current password. Changing it signs out your other sessions.
web.profile.codeInvalid: That code didn't work. Check the code and try again.
web.settings.help.general: Identity, the sender address and the public pages. The root URL is used in every link in your emails, so subscribers must be able to reach it.
web.settings.help.performance: How fast campaigns are sent. Start low and raise concurrency and message rate while watching your mail server's limits.
web.settings.help.privacy: What is tracked and what subscribers can do themselves. Disabling tracking removes view and click statistics.
web.settings.help.security: Single sign-on (OIDC), CAPTCHA on the public subscription form, and the origins allowed to call the API from a browser.
web.settings.help.media: Where uploaded files are stored. Filesystem needs a writable folder on the server; S3 needs a bucket and credentials.
web.settings.help.smtp: The mail servers campaigns go through. Messages are spread across all enabled servers.
web.settings.help.bounces: How bounces are detected and what happens after repeated ones. Needs a POP mailbox, provider webhooks, or both.
web.settings.help.messengers: Extra delivery channels. Each one is a URL that receives every message as JSON.
web.settings.help.appearance: Custom CSS and JavaScript for the admin and for the public pages. Broken code breaks the pages it is added to.
web.settings.saveHint: Saving reloads the app, which takes a few seconds.
web.notices.legacyUser: Remove the admin_username and admin_password fields from the TOML configuration file or environment variables. If you use the API, create and use new API credentials first. Manage them under
web.automations.title: Automations
web.automations.archiveWarning: Everyone inside is taken out and nothing more is sent. This cannot be undone.
web.automations.draftSavedProblems: Draft saved, but {n} thing needs fixing before it can go live | Draft saved, but {n} things need fixing before it can go live
web.automations.cannotPublish: Cannot publish: {n} problem found | Cannot publish: {n} problems found
web.automations.publish.title: Publish changes
web.automations.publish.help: People who are already inside carry on with the version they entered. New people get this version.
web.automations.publish.helpFirst: It goes live now and starts enrolling people whenever its trigger happens.
web.automations.publish.enrollExisting: Also enroll people already on the list
web.automations.publish.enrollExistingHe: Everyone currently on the trigger list enters now. Without this, only people who join from now on do.
web.automations.liveNote: This automation is live. Changes below are saved as a draft and only apply to new people once you publish.
web.automations.incomplete: {n} step needs attention | {n} steps need attention
web.automations.nothingToSet: Nothing to set up for this step.
web.automations.trigger.list_joined_help: Starts when someone becomes a subscriber of a list.
web.automations.trigger.attribute_change: Starts when a subscriber attribute is set or changed.
web.automations.trigger.event_help: Starts when your application reports an event with the tracking API.
web.automations.trigger.manual: Added by hand or by API
web.automations.trigger.manual_help: Starts only when you enroll people yourself.
web.automations.trigger.becomesHelp: Leave empty to start on any change.
web.automations.trigger.eventHelp2: The name your application sends to POST /api/track.
web.automations.step.send_email_help: Sends a message, if the person may receive it.
web.automations.step.delay_help: Pause for a length of time.
web.automations.step.wait_until_help: Pause until a date, or a date held in an attribute.
web.automations.step.condition_help: Send people down one of two paths.
web.automations.step.update_attribute_he: Change or remove a subscriber attribute.
web.automations.step.add_to_list_help: Subscribe the person to a list.
web.automations.step.remove_from_list_he: Take the person off a list.
web.automations.step.exit_help: Finish the automation for this person.
web.automations.email.marketingHelp: Not sent to people who unsubscribed from the topic, or who have not confirmed it.
web.automations.email.transactionalHelp: Sent even to people who unsubscribed from the topic. Never to blocklisted people.
web.automations.email.topicHelp: The list this email is about. Its unsubscribe link takes people off this list.
web.automations.email.contentRequired: Write the email or choose a template.
web.automations.email.noTemplates: There are no transactional templates yet.
web.automations.email.sharedNote: Saved on its own. It applies to everyone who has not been sent this step yet, in every version.
web.automations.condition.help: People who match go down the Yes path, everyone else down No.
web.automations.condition.trackingOff: Opened and clicked can only be told apart per person when individual tracking is on (Settings, Privacy). It is off, so these tests never match.
web.automations.invalidDuration: Use a number and a unit, such as 30m, 2h, 3d or 1w.
web.automations.delay.help: Counted from when the person reaches this step.
web.automations.waitUntil.attribute: A date stored on the subscriber
web.automations.waitUntil.attributeHelp: People without a valid date there skip this step.
web.automations.waitUntil.either: Choose a date or an attribute.
web.automations.attribute.name: Attribute
web.automations.attribute.help: Nested names work, such as address.city.
web.automations.addToList.help: Automatic: confirmed on single opt-in lists, unconfirmed (a confirmation is requested) on double opt-in ones.
web.automations.rule.fields.name: Name
web.automations.rule.stepRequired: Choose an email that comes earlier.
web.automations.rule.sqlNotAllowed: Raw SQL needs the permission to run SQL queries on subscribers.
web.automations.rule.sqlHelp: A condition on the subscriber, written as s.column or s.attribs->>'key'. Runs read-only.
web.automations.reentry.title: Can someone go through it again?
web.automations.reentry.intervalHelp: They can enter again once this long has passed since they last entered.
web.automations.reentry.alwaysHelp: As often as the trigger happens, as long as they are not already inside.
web.automations.window.title: Only send at certain times
web.automations.window.help: Emails wait for the next allowed moment, in the person’s own timezone.
web.automations.window.daysHelp: Leave all days unticked for every day.
web.automations.window.order: The end must be after the start.
web.automations.timezone.title: Default timezone
web.automations.timezone.help: Used for people without a timezone attribute. Empty means UTC.
web.automations.goal.title: End early when a goal is reached
web.automations.goal.help: Checked whenever someone is between steps. Whoever matches leaves the automation.
web.automations.skipReason.no_date: No valid date, so the wait was skipped
web.automations.versions.help: Each publish makes a new version. People already inside stay on the version they entered.
web.maintenance.eventsHelp: Events recorded through the tracking API. Automations only look at events inside the window their conditions ask for.
web.common.noResultsHelp: Nothing matches the current search or filters.
web.campaigns.emptyHelp: A campaign is one message sent to one or more lists. Start with a draft, you can send a test before it goes out.
web.subscribers.emptyHelp: Add people one by one, import a CSV, or let them sign up through a public form.
web.lists.emptyHelp: Lists group subscribers by topic. Campaigns are sent to one or more lists.
web.automations.emptyHelp: Automations send e-mails and update subscribers on their own, triggered by list sign-ups, events or dates.
web.bounces.emptyHelp: Bounced e-mails reported by your mail server or provider show up here.
web.forms.description: Generate HTML for a sign-up form to put on your website. Only public lists can be offered.
web.campaigns.audienceHelp: Everyone subscribed to these lists receives the campaign (unsubscribed and blocklisted addresses are skipped).
web.messages.title: Sent messages
web.messages.description: Every email the app handed to your mail server, and whether it was accepted.
web.messages.subject: Subject
web.messages.emptyHelp: Emails the app sends are listed here, with the result.
web.messages.rerenderNote: This copy is rebuilt from the campaign and the subscriber as they are now. If either changed since it was sent, it can differ from what was delivered.
web.messages.noContent: The content of this message isn't kept.
web.messages.cannotRender: This email can't be rebuilt any more: its campaign or subscriber was deleted.
web.maintenance.messageLogHelp: The record of sent emails. Messages older than the retention (90 days by default) are also removed automatically.
